Summary: Finds the users and apps that stop working when Microsoft retires SMS and voice MFA in Entra ID and Exchange Web Services in Exchange Online. Read-only.

Steps.Text: Connect Maester to Microsoft Graph and Exchange Online.

Notes: Without an Exchange Online connection, MP.RETIRE.1004 is skipped and the other checks still run.
MP.RETIRE.1001 and MP.RETIRE.1002 need Microsoft Entra ID P1 or better; Maester skips them without it.

Commands.Text: Maester's tests and the retirement checks

Options.Name: MP.RETIRE.1001 MaximumRows
Options.Text: The most users to list in the result.

Options.Name: MP.RETIRE.1002 MaximumRows
Options.Text: The most admins to list in the result.
